conventions: Paths are relative to the repo root. Line numbers are from HEAD 845ba2f, and nothing under App/lib or App/test is uncommitted (another session's App/pubspec.yaml, App/scripts/ and App/config/ aside). The five packages share no file but the ARB catalogs and test files, which don't count as shared, so they run side by side in one wave: P259, P260, P261, P262 and P263. P259 and P261 both update tests in the group 'P256 · D6' of App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart (:5291) and both change App/test/ux_previews/reminders_previews.dart: change only the tests and previews your brief names, and keep to your own hunks. P262 calls `reminderRingsHere` from App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart, which P259 changes and keeps with its name and signature.

Copy is exact, shown as ES / EN / CA. EN copy sits between “ ”, or between backticks when it holds its own quotes or braces; ES and CA sit between « », or between backticks when they hold their own « » or braces. Keep the catalogs' marks: “…” and ’ in English; «…» in Spanish and Catalan; ’ in Catalan; ICU plurals and selects as written. Every new or changed string goes in app_en.arb, app_es.arb and app_ca.arb (App/docs/LOCALIZATION.md), with an accurate @key description in app_en.arb. Run flutter gen-l10n; never edit lib/l10n/generated/. Where the organizer wrote the Catalan, the brief says so. The ARB catalogs merge key by key between packages: add, change or remove only your keys, and don't reorder or reformat others. Names a brief gives «for example» are suggestions.

Owner decisions bind every package (.claude/ux-review/DECISIONS.md), above all the newest, «D8 of run 2026-10-22-changes, and the single reminder on shared tasks» (2026-10-23), in his words. D8 (b): a plan with a time of its own, said or typed, keeps that time on the task's own day; only plans without one (the strengths, «Sí» to the offer, a rhythm said without an hour) move the day's notice to the task's usual reminder (D1). And every reminder choice for a task (none; once, with its lead or time and what it counts from; a plan) is each person's own: it rings only for them, changing it changes nobody else's, and someone who hasn't chosen gets their own defaults from Settings. That closes the Open item of 2026-10-22: «Una vez» is no longer one setting for the whole task. The earlier entries still bind: «D1–D7 of run 2026-10-22-changes» and «Reminder plans» (2026-10-22), D2 of 2026-10-13 (the one-time reminder question) and D1 of 2026-10-20 (UX-1601: ask only when a reminder can still ring here).

The contract binds the app: Backend/docs/REMINDER_PLANS.md, updated by the main session for both answers (49c8eeb). «Every reminder is personal»: the task API's reminder_minutes, reminder_time, reminder_anchor and reminder_plan are always the asking account's own values or the defaults, a change to them alone makes no new version, activity entry or notification, and nobody's values are ever sent to anyone else. «A time of the plan's own stays (D8)». «Shared tasks»: the reminder choices show wherever the task's reminders ring on this phone (a personal task, a «Todos» task, one given to you, an unassigned one in a project you manage), and not on a task given to someone else, whose reminders are theirs and never sent to this phone. The server half is done and the app's API and local database don't change: the app keeps reading and sending the four fields as it does, and on this phone they are this account's own, on every task. No package changes Backend/: what the contract should say after your change goes in your notes for the main session.

The speed bar holds: a plain one-task dictation stays Añadir tarea → speak → Listo → one confirming tap, and looks and saves as today. The test 'a plain single-task dictation looks and saves exactly as before, with no new tap' (App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart:1019) keeps passing. Judge every screen as a first-time, non-technical user would, in Spanish, often at large text: the owner's father.

Where a task isn't this account's, it shows less, never new copy.

Plugin registrant files under App/linux, App/macos and App/windows that a `flutter pub get` modifies aren't any package's. Don't edit, format or stage any of them.

packages.title: A task given to someone else shows none of your reminder and offers no choices; on shared tasks, the one-tap list and «Recordar antes de» say «solo para ti»
brief: The owner, 2026-10-23 (DECISIONS.md, «D8 of run 2026-10-22-changes, and the single reminder on shared tasks»), in his words: «one person change affects everyone's phone. That shouldn't happen. So it should become personal, like plans.» Every reminder choice for a task (none; once, with its lead or time and what it counts from; a plan) is each person's own: it rings only for them, and changing it changes nobody else's; someone who hasn't chosen gets their own defaults from Settings. The server half is committed (49c8eeb): the task API's reminder_minutes, reminder_time, reminder_anchor and reminder_plan are always the asking account's own values or the defaults, and nobody's values are ever sent to anyone else. The app's API and local database don't change, so on this phone `task.reminderMinutes`, `reminderTime`, `reminderAnchor` and `reminderPlan` are this account's own, on every task. The contract (Backend/docs/REMINDER_PLANS.md, «Shared tasks»): the reminder choices show wherever the task's reminders ring on this phone; they don't show on a task given to someone else, whose reminders are theirs and never sent to this phone. This package makes the task's line, the form's row, the capture card and the planning control say and do that. The reminder sheet itself is P261's, which runs beside this one: don't touch App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart.

UX-2024 (S2), «Recordatorio para Ana: …» shows this account's reminder as Ana's. On a task given to a named member (`assignment == 'member'`, `assigneeName` set, not this account), `_Reason.text` (App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart:130-137) reads `reminderForPerson(name, value)` whenever the task's values differ from the default: «Recordatorio para Ana: 1 hora antes», «… : 8:00», «… : Desactivado», «… : Fecha límite · 10 minutos antes». Those values are María's own and never reach Ana, whose reminders are hers and unknown here (the owner: show no value as someone else's). Fix: such a task always reads `reminderForPersonOnly`, «Recordatorio para Ana» / “Reminder for Ana” / «Recordatori per a Ana», whatever this account's minutes, time, anchor or plan: on the task detail's chip, the form's «Recordatorio» row (its subtitle), the capture card's «Recordatorio» row, a collapsed row's reminder line, and «Más opciones»' subtitle where the card adds the reminder line (App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart:821-832). Remove `reminderForPerson` and `@reminderForPerson` from app_en.arb, app_es.arb and app_ca.arb, and let `_Reason.text` take no value. Replace the `@reminderForPersonOnly` description with: `The reminder line on a task given to someone else. Their reminders are their own and never reach this phone, so none of this account's reminder values is shown. {name} is the person's name.` Its three values don't change. Keep the line's bell (`Icons.notifications_outlined`), as today.

UX-2025 (S2), on a task given to someone else, the reminder choices change nothing. Today a tap on «Recordatorio para Ana» (the chip, `reminderLine`'s onTap, reminder_control.dart:543-567; the form's and the card's row, `ReminderControl`'s onTap, :692-715) opens the single reminder's one-tap list (`_chooseReminder` with no schedule → `_pickFrom`), and a choice saves this account's own value, which never rings here (the engine skips a task that isn't this account's: `TaskDatabase.reminderBlock` → `ReminderBlock.notForAccount`, App/lib/services/task_database.dart:404-425) and never reaches Ana. Likewise «Recordar antes de» under a deadline (App/lib/widgets/task_planning_control.dart:165-177) sets this account's own anchor, and the capture card asks «Para recordártelo, ponle un día.» (`needsDay`, capture_review_editor.dart:569-573) for a draft whose reminder could never ring for this account. Fix, for any task whose reminders are someone else's (`notForAccount`): the line and the rows have no tap and no chevron, and no «Activar recordatorios» under them; the form's row reads the person line whether or not the task has a date (not «Añade una fecha para usar un recordatorio», which is for this account's own tasks); «Recordar antes de» isn't shown, and the «Fecha límite» row above it stays; the card shows no «Para recordártelo, ponle un día.» for it. A line with no tap reads as information, not as a switched-off control: the chip without a tap is drawn at full contrast (for example a plain `Chip` with the same avatar and label, instead of an `ActionChip` with no `onPressed`, whose label Material draws at 38%), and the card's collapsed line is a button for TalkBack only when it has a tap (`_reminderLine()`, capture_review_editor.dart:409-438: `button: onTap != null`). That holds for every chip without a tap, archived projects and accounts without edit rights included; their words and taps don't change.

UX-2028 (S1), a task that isn't this account's and names nobody shows this account's reminder as if it rang. `_reasonFor` (reminder_control.dart:152-162) gives a reason only to a task given to a named member, so other tasks that aren't this account's «read as before»: an unassigned task («Necesita responsable») in a project this account doesn't own or administer, which rings on the managers' phones with their own reminders, or a member's task with no name, reads «Recordatorio: 10 minutos antes» and opens the choices, all of it this account's own and ringing nowhere. Fix: such a task shows no reminder at all, rather than new copy: no chip on the task detail and no 16 dp gap after it (App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart:368-403), no «Recordatorio» row in the form or on the card, nothing on a collapsed row or in «Más opciones»' subtitle, no needs-day line, and no «Recordar antes de». An unassigned task in a project this account owns or administers is this account's (`Task.isForAccount`), and reads and opens as today.

UX-2027 (S2), on a shared task, the reminder choices outside the sheet never say they're only for you. P261 puts «Estos avisos son solo para ti.» under the reminder sheet's title, over every choice there. Two other places offer reminder choices on a shared task and say nothing: the one-tap list (`_pickFrom`, reminder_control.dart:427-466), which a repeating task gets instead of the sheet (`_chooseReminder`, :382-391; for example «Sacar la basura» every Monday for «Todos»), and «Recordar antes de» (task_planning_control.dart:165-177), which sits right under the deadline row, which is shared. Fix: on a shared task (`reminderShared`, reminder_control.dart:190-194) the one-tap list shows the existing `reminderPlanJustYou`, «Estos avisos son solo para ti.» / “These reminders are only for you.” / «Aquests avisos són només per a tu.», under its title and above its first row, in bodyMedium and onSurfaceVariant, padded as the title is (24 at the sides, 8 below), with the key `reminder-plan-just-you` (the sheet's line has the same key); and «Recordar antes de» shows the same words as its helper (`InputDecoration.helperText`, `helperMaxLines: 3`). Not on a personal task, and never in Ajustes › Recordatorios' «Tareas con hora» list (`chooseDefaultLead`, :414-424, which also uses `_pickFrom`). No new string: don't change `reminderPlanJustYou`'s values or its @description (P261 rewrites the description for every place that shows it).

How (suggestions; say what you chose in your notes). Export one predicate from reminder_control.dart, for example `bool reminderSomeoneElses(WidgetRef ref, Task? task)`: true when `_blockFor` (:170-182) is `ReminderBlock.notForAccount`. `_reasonFor` then gives a reason to every such task, with the person's name for a named member; `reminderLine` (:476-569) returns null for one with no name, `ReminderChip` (:571-605) and `ReminderControl` (:607-769) build nothing then, and the card's two uses of `reminderLine` (:409-438, :821-832) skip it. `ReminderControl` decides the person line before `dated` (:658-659). `TaskPlanningControl` gets two optional parameters, for example `bool showReminderAnchor = true` and `String? reminderNote`: the editor passes them for `_responsibility` (App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart:1045-1053; `_responsibility` is :85), and the card for its task inside a `Consumer`, as `_reminderLine()` reads `reminderLine` (capture_review_editor.dart:873-876; the card's State isn't a ConsumerState). The card's `needsDay` (:569-573) also needs the task to be this account's: read it in a Consumer too, or pass it down. The detail builds the chip, and its 16 dp gap, only when there's a line. Keep `reminderRingsHere` and `reminderShared` with their names and signatures (P262 uses `reminderRingsHere`). Muted and archived projects keep their words, icons and taps.

Tests your change rightly breaks, to update (they assert the old reading): App/test/reminder_settings_test.dart:786 (UX-1505's catalog test: drop its three `reminderForPerson` expects, keep the muted and archived ones), :1006-1038 (UX-1634: Ana's timed task with 30 minutes now reads «Recordatorio para Ana»), :1052-1079 (her date-only task with 8:00 or «Desactivado» reads «Recordatorio para Ana»), :1081-1120 (the form's row reads «Recordatorio para Ana» in all four cases); App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart in the group 'P256 · D6': the loop 'UX-2014: $what gets the title and the single reminder's rows only' (:5481-5506: the task given to Marta now opens nothing, and the unassigned task in «Club», where you're an editor, shows no chip), 'UX-2014: the same with its own lead of 60 …' (:5571-5604: «Recordatorio para Marta», and the chip opens nothing), 'UX-2014: in the form, the same task given to Marta has no plan rows' (:5664-5676: the row opens nothing) and 'UX-2014: on the capture card, a draft in the project given to Marta …' (:5706-5732: the row reads «Recordatorio para Marta» and opens nothing). Say in your notes which you changed.

Previews (App/test/ux_previews/reminders_previews.dart): replace `planSheet` 'given-to-someone' (:336-349), whose sheet can no longer open, with a `planLine` preview 'given-to-someone' (es 1×, ca 2×): the task detail of the same shared task given to Ana, carrying this account's `reminderMinutes: 60`, its chip reading «Recordatorio para Ana» at full contrast. Add a `planSheet` preview 'shared-repeating' (es 1×, ca 2×): a «Todos» task in «Matemáticas» that repeats every Monday, its one-tap list open, with «Estos avisos son solo para ti.» under «Recordatorio». Re-render reminders/ and keep each description true.

Not yours: App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart and `@reminderPlanJustYou` (P261), App/lib/screens/notification_settings_screen.dart (P262), `sharedDataHelp` (P260), the reminder engine, which already rings only the tasks that are this account's, and Backend/. No new string.
acceptance: Task detail, ES 1× on 360×800, the shared project «Equipo» (this account owns it; Marta is an editor), «Presentar el proyecto» on Fri 13 Nov given to Marta: with this account's `reminderMinutes: 60` on the task at 17:00, `reminderTime: 480` on the date-only one, `reminderMinutes: -1`, a deadline with `reminderAnchor: 'deadline'`, and Normal, the chip reads exactly «Recordatorio para Marta» every time; in EN “Reminder for Marta”, in CA «Recordatori per a Marta». packages.title: The sharing help says reminders aren't shared: each person has their own
brief: UX-2029 (S2), the sharing help says reminder choices are shared. On a shared project's «Miembros» screen, «Cómo funciona compartir» (App/lib/screens/list_sharing_screen.dart:478-488) holds three paragraphs. The second, `sharedDataHelp` (app_es.arb:540, app_en.arb:1144, app_ca.arb:519), ends «Las opciones de recordatorio se comparten, pero cada teléfono debe activar sus propias notificaciones.» / “Task reminder choices are shared, but each phone must enable its own notifications.” Since the owner's answer of 2026-10-23 (DECISIONS.md) and the server's 49c8eeb, every reminder choice is each person's own and nobody's values are ever sent to anyone else (Backend/docs/REMINDER_PLANS.md, «Every reminder is personal»), so that sentence now says the opposite of what the app does. It is the one string in the three catalogs that says a reminder reaches other members.

Fix: replace only that last sentence; the first two stay word for word. ES «Se comparten tareas, notas y archivos subidos. Los editores pueden modificarlos o eliminarlos; los lectores pueden consultarlos. Los recordatorios no se comparten: cada persona tiene los suyos.» EN “Tasks, notes and uploaded files are shared. Editors can change or remove them; viewers can read them. Reminders aren’t shared: each person has their own.” CA «Les tasques, notes i fitxers pujats es comparteixen. Els editors els poden canviar o suprimir; els lectors els poden consultar. Els recordatoris no es comparteixen: cada persona té els seus.» (the organizer's Catalan). «tiene los suyos» rather than «elige los suyos»: a reader can't choose reminders yet (D9), but has their own defaults. Add an `@sharedDataHelp` description to app_en.arb, which has none: `Sharing screen, under “How sharing works”: what a shared project shares. Reminders are each person’s own (none of their values reaches anyone else), so the last sentence says they aren’t shared.`

Evidence: no preview shows «Cómo funciona compartir» open. Add one in App/test/ux_previews/sharing_previews.dart, for example `project-sharing.how-it-works` (es 1×, ca 2×, 360×800): the owner's «Miembros» screen of a shared project with «Cómo funciona compartir» open and scrolled so its three paragraphs show. Re-render sharing/ and keep INDEX true.
Not yours: list_sharing_screen.dart's layout, the other two paragraphs and every other key; App/lib/widgets/ (P259 and P261) and App/lib/screens/notification_settings_screen.dart (P262).

Los editores pueden modificarlos o eliminarlos; los lectores pueden consultarlos. Los recordatorios no se comparten: cada persona tiene los suyos.»; in EN and CA it reads the brief's text.
At 2× in ES and CA on 360×800, that paragraph shows whole, with nothing clipped, once scrolled into view.

packages.title: D8: a plan's own hour stays on the task's day; the reminder sheet's «solo para ti» covers every choice; the Catalan strip keeps its date on one line
brief: UX-2022 (S2), D8, answered by the owner on 2026-10-23 as recommended, (b): «yeah, absolutely, it should be kept» (DECISIONS.md; contract Backend/docs/REMINDER_PLANS.md, «A time of the plan's own stays (D8)»). A plan with a time of its own, said or typed («recuérdamelo el mismo día a las 9», «cada día a las 8»), keeps that time on the task's own day too. Only a plan without a time of its own (the strengths, «Sí» to the offer, a rhythm said without an hour) moves the day's notice to the task's usual reminder, as D1 says and P252 built. Today P252's rule moves every plan's day: `ReminderPlans.dayLead` (App/lib/services/reminder_plans.dart:73-90) never looks at the plan, so «Dentista el viernes a las 17:00, recuérdamelo el mismo día a las 9» rings at 16:50, and «cada día a las 8» rings at 8:00 on the days before and at 16:50 on the day.

The rule. `dayLead` returns null when the plan it's for has a time of its own (`plan.time != null`): that plan's day rings at its time, as its other days do. Give it the plan as an optional named parameter, for example `static int? dayLead(Task task, int defaultLead, {ReminderPlan? plan})`, defaulting to `task.reminderPlan`, and say why in its doc comment (D8). Nothing in the app sets a plan's `time` except words said or typed (the dictation's, or «A tu manera»'s): `ReminderPlan.withTime` has no caller, and the sheet builds its strengths with no time, so `time != null` is exactly «a time of its own».

Every place that shows that time follows, with no new copy. The callers that pass a task carrying the plan in effect need no change, and must not change: `taskAlerts` (:119-136), the engine's `planReminders` (App/lib/services/reminder_engine.dart:183-215, which gets `ReminderPlans.active(task)`), and, in App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart (P259's file: don't touch it), `reminderPlanText` and `_alertPassed`. So the task's chip, the form's line, the capture card's row and `ReminderEngine.alertAhead` follow by themselves. The sheet doesn't: it works the lead out once from `widget.task` (App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart:474-478) and gives it to every preview, though each previews another plan. Work it out for each plan shown: Normal's preview with `ReminderPlan.rhythm(_strength)` (:582-588), the dictated row's subtitle (:618-625) and the free account's read-only preview (:640-646) with `dictated`, and «A tu manera»'s preview with the plan read from the words (:733-739). So on one sheet a plan said with an hour keeps it, and Normal, which has none, still moves.

The notice. With no lead, the engine already schedules the day as a plain plan notice: identity `…/plan/<date>` with no `/time`, the plan's body for that day («Es hoy a las 17:00» / «És avui a les 17:00» / “It’s today at 5:00 PM”; «Fecha límite: hoy a las 17:00» for a deadline with a time), «Completar» only and the iOS `plan_<lang>` category (UX-2009), no snooze; nothing is scheduled at 16:50. Check that this holds, and update the doc comments of `planReminders` (reminder_engine.dart:178-182) and `isPlanDayAlert` (:159-162) so they say D1 applies to a plan without a time of its own (D8). Notices already set with the old `/time` identity are replaced at the next reconcile, as any change is.

UX-2026 (S2), on a shared task the sheet's «Estos avisos son solo para ti.» doesn't cover the single reminder. P256 put the line above each «Listo» (`_JustYou`, reminder_plan_sheet.dart:590, :648, :741; class :769-786), so it shows only once a plan is open. The single reminder's rows, which apply in one tap with no «Listo» (:521-533), never get it, though since 2026-10-23 they too are only this person's; the owner: it «must cover every reminder choice, not only plans». Fix: on a shared task (`widget.shared`), one line under the sheet's title, above the first row, that doesn't scroll: the title and the line sit above the scrolling choices, so the line stays in view while a plan's section is open and when the sheet opens scrolled to a plan (UX-1810's opening scroll, :173-189). For example: `SafeArea` → the viewInsets `Padding` → a `Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min)` with the title, the line and a `Flexible` `SingleChildScrollView` holding the rows and the plans; the `Scrollable.ensureVisible` calls (on opening, in `_toggle` and in `_reveal`) then scroll the choices under it, as now. Remove the three copies above «Listo». Same copy, style (bodyMedium, onSurfaceVariant) and key `reminder-plan-just-you`; padding 24 at the sides and 8 below, as the title's. On any other task the sheet is unchanged, title included. Update the doc comment of `showReminderPlanSheet` (:37-45), and replace the `@reminderPlanJustYou` description in app_en.arb with: `On a task in a shared project, says that every reminder choice there rings only for the person who makes it: shown under the title of the reminder sheet and of the one-tap reminder list, and as the helper of “Remind before”.` The three values don't change. (P259 shows the same words in the one-tap list and under «Recordar antes de», and doesn't touch this key.)

UX-2031 (S1), at Catalan 2× the strip's end label breaks before its final «.». Under the strip of dots, «Hoy» and the task's day each take half the row (`Expanded`, reminder_plan_sheet.dart:864-886). A far day in Catalan, «dt., 22 de des.» (`planDay` joins its parts with no-break spaces), is wider than half the row at 2× on 360 dp, so it breaks inside the word and its «.» falls alone onto a second line (render reminders/sheet.strength-far.ca.light.2x, seen by review B in plan 2's round 1, verify-p2-r1-B). Fix: «Hoy» / «Avui» / “Today” takes its own width and the day takes the rest of the row, right-aligned (for example `Text(today)`, a small gap, then `Expanded(child: Text(day, textAlign: TextAlign.end))`). No smaller text, no FittedBox, and keep the no-break spaces.

Tests your change rightly breaks, to update: in App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart's group 'P256 · D6' (:5291), `expectJustAboveListo` (:5371-5392) and its callers (:5442, :5477, :5660, :5921), which expect the line directly above «Listo»: it is now once, under the title; and the loop 'UX-2014: on $what in a shared project, the sheet offers the plans, …' (:5415-5452) and 'UX-2014: on a «Todos» task, «A tu manera» says the line above «Listo» once a plan is read' (:5454-5480), which expect no line until a plan is open: it now shows from the start. P252's groups (App/test/reminder_plan_engine_test.dart:574, reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart:4049) use Normal, which has no time, and must pass unchanged. Say in your notes which you changed.

Previews (reminders_previews.dart): re-render `sheet.shared` (es 1×, es 2×, ca 2×) with its description saying the line sits under the title, over every choice, and `sheet.strength-far` (its ca 2× now shows the end label on one line). Add a `planLine` preview 'own-time-today' (es 1×, es 2×): «Presentar el proyecto» today at 17:00 with the plan said «el mismo día a las 9», viewed at 8:00, its chip «Recordatorios: el mismo día · próximo: hoy, 09:00».

Not yours: App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart, capture_review_editor.dart, task_editor.dart and task_planning_control.dart (P259), notification_settings_screen.dart (P262), `reminderPlanJustYou`'s values, the strengths and the offer, and Backend/ (the contract already says D8).

packages.title: Ajustes › Recordatorios counts only the plans that ring on this phone
brief: UX-2030 (S1), Ajustes › Recordatorios counts plans that don't ring here. With «Tareas sin hora» off, its row reads «Desactivado · «Hasta la fecha límite»: 9:00» when `_plansWithoutTime()` (App/lib/screens/notification_settings_screen.dart:366-372) finds an open task with a plan without a time of its own (UX-2011, P247). It looks at every task on the phone. Plans are each person's own (D6), and P256 hides a plan wherever it can't ring here: on a task given to someone else (this account's plan, kept from before it was given) and in a project muted or archived on this phone. So the row can promise 9:00 notices that this phone never rings and that no other screen shows.

Fix: count only the tasks that ring here, by the rule the engine schedules with, through the existing `reminderRingsHere(ref, task)` (App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart:184-188; the screen already imports that file). Don't change reminder_control.dart: P259 changes it beside you and keeps that function as it is. No copy change.

Tests: the UX-2011 tests in the group 'P247' of App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart (:2380-2506, with `dateOnlyRow` :2383) must pass unchanged; the group 'P256 · D6' (:5291) shows how to build a shared, a muted and an archived project (`TaskListInfo`).
Not yours: every other row and the screen's layout; reminder_control.dart, reminder_plan_sheet.dart and the ARB catalogs.

The same task as a «Todos» task of the shared project, or as a personal task, reads «Desactivado · «Hasta la fecha límite»: 9:00», and UX-2011's tests pass unchanged.

packages.title: The first reminder question comes only after saving a task that rings on this phone
brief: UX-2033 (S1), the first reminder question can follow a save of a task that never rings here. On an account and phone not asked yet, with reminders off, `_ask` (App/lib/widgets/reminder_ask_sheet.dart:94-189) shows «¿Quieres un recordatorio antes?» when any dated task just saved has a reminder ahead (`ReminderEngine.alertAhead`, :148-151), whoever it's for. So a first dated save of a task given to Ana (for example added under Ana's chip in a shared project, which makes it hers: D7 of 2026-10-18) asks it, though no reminder of this account ever rings for that task (`TaskDatabase.reminderBlock` → `ReminderBlock.notForAccount`) and Ana's reminders are hers; «Sí, recuérdamelo» then turns reminders on for a task that stays silent. The same holds for a task in a project muted or archived on this phone. UX-1601's rule (D1 of 2026-10-20) is to ask only after a save whose reminder can still ring here, and the plan offer already keeps to it (`ringsHere`, :238-255). Found by the organizer while checking the flows of the personal reminder; it predates 2026-10-23.

Fix: the question counts only the saved tasks that ring on this phone, by the offer's own rule: hoist `ringsHere` out of `_offer` (:204) so `_ask` and `_offer` share it, with the projects read as `_offer` reads them (`taskListsProvider.future`, :229-234; a project this phone doesn't know yet isn't asked). When none of the saved tasks rings here, nothing is asked and the account isn't marked asked, as UX-1601 already does when no reminder can fire, so the next dated save of a task that rings here asks. No copy change.
Not yours: the offer's conditions and copy, P255's decline count, App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart (P259) and App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart (P261).
acceptance: A new account (reminders off, never asked) that belongs to a shared project with Marta: saving a task given to Marta for tomorrow at 17:00 from the form, ES 1× on 360×800, brings no «¿Quieres un recordatorio antes?» once the save message has gone, and the account stays not asked; saving a personal task for tomorrow at 17:00 afterwards asks it.
Saving a «Todos» task of that project, or a task given to this account, asks it as before; a task in a project muted on this phone doesn't.
The existing question tests (App/test/reminder_ask_sheet_test.dart, UX-401, UX-439, UX-1601 :868) and the offer's (UX-2003, UX-2013, UX-2014) pass unchanged.

decisions.question: Can a reader choose their own reminders? (UX-2032, S1, filed by the organizer.) Since 2026-10-23 every reminder is personal. In a shared project, a «lector» (viewer) gets the reminders of «Todos» tasks on their phone, with their own defaults from Ajustes, but can choose none: the app gives the reminder line no tap without edit rights (App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart:375), and the server refuses any change to a task from a viewer, their own reminders included (Backend/core/list_access.py:75, through `lock_task`). Your words for D6: «everyone should be able to set their own pattern for reminder frequency». Options: (a) as now: a reader keeps their own defaults, and can mute the project on their phone; (b) a reader can choose their own reminders on the tasks that ring for them: the server accepts a reader's change that touches only their own reminders (no version, activity or notification, as for anyone), and the app opens the usual choices for them.
decisions.recommendation: (b). A reader's reminders now change nothing for anyone else, so being a reader needn't stop them. The server goes first (the main session), then one small app package; reversible. Readers are rare (everyone joins as an editor, D6 of 2026-10-20), so nothing waits for this, and P260's sharing help says «cada persona tiene los suyos», which holds either way.
